title: Any Last Words?
description: Sends a message in chat with your last death coordinates
body:
# Any Last Words?
Never forget where you died again.

Any Last Words is a lightweight client-side mod that automatically sends your death coordinates to your chat the moment you die — only visible to you.

## Features

- Instant death coordinates — shows X, Y, Z in chat the moment you die
- Dimension tracking — displays whether you died in the Overworld, The Nether, or The End
- Precise coordinates — optionally show decimal coordinates for pinpoint accuracy
- Fully configurable — toggle any feature on or off via the in-game config screen
- Client-side only — works on any server, no server-side installation needed

## Requirements

- Fabric API
- ModMenu (Optional, for config screen)

## What it does
When you die, you'll see a message like:

You died at X: 142, Y: 63, Z: -887 [The Nether] in chat

(This is only visible to YOU)
